mapper.select: SELECT fnd03_consignment_id AS consignment_id, fnd03_consignment_cd AS consignment_code, fnd03_consignment_nm AS consignment_name, fnd03_use_yn AS use_yn, fnd03_note AS note, fnd03_company_id AS company_id FROM fnd03_consignment WHERE fnd03_company_id = 0 AND fnd03_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( ( #{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(fnd03_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) OR ( #{useYn} = 'false' ) ) AND UPPER(CONCAT(fnd03_consignment_cd,fnd03_consignment_nm)) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{searchText})||'%' ORDER BY fnd03_consignment_cd

SELECT fnd03_consignment_id AS consignment_id, fnd03_consignment_cd AS consignment_code, fnd03_consignment_nm AS consignment_name, fnd03_use_yn AS use_yn, fnd03_note AS note, fnd03_company_id AS company_id FROM fnd03_consignment WHERE fnd03_consignment_id = #{consignmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd03_consignment ( fnd03_consignment_id, fnd03_consignment_cd, fnd03_consignment_nm, fnd03_use_yn, fnd03_note, fnd03_company_id ) VALUES ( #{consignmentId}, #{req.consignmentCode}, #{req.consignmentName}, #{req.useYn}, #{req.note}, #{companyId} )
